profitPct.label: Profit %
profitPct.hint: P&L at this instant as % of the equity on the first frame.

profitUsd.label: Profit $
profitUsd.hint: Equity at this instant minus equity on the first frame.

cost.label: LLM cost $
cost.hint: Cumulative LLM cost of the agent's cycles up to this instant. Buy & Keep has no cost.

maxDrawdownPct.label: Max drawdown %
maxDrawdownPct.hint: Largest peak-to-trough fall of the equity up to this instant, as % of that peak.

winRatePct.label: Win rate %
winRatePct.hint: Winning closes over every close so far.

unrealized.label: Unrealized $
unrealized.hint: Unrealized P&L of the open positions.
